searchText: Hey folx— I compulsively count colors, enjoy patterns, and am trying to get as much knowledge as possible to not only understand cryptocurrency better, but how to be more savvy in an eco-friendly fashion. 🤷‍♀️ I will fully admit I’m intimidated by some of your amazing credentials. omg I found a discord full of nerds Hello folks! I'm a young nerdy guy from brazil who struggle to learn things alone on internet since I remember myself as a person Since I don't have much access to formal education, I just try to huebr around on internet, here in my country blockchain is treated like something from another world, so I hope I can connect with experienced people to learn anything My english is not perfect, but i'm still learning too. If you feel like you want to talk, please contact me, I would like to talk too I have 22 years old, I'm very curious person and I am always interesting on some topic about technology. I'm still very very beginner on blockchain/Ethereum topics, but I'm not afraid to learn everyday! Now the current question I struggle to understand is: "What still needs to be improved to Ethereum become a world widely-used platform?" and "Why no one uses it if is it so disruptive? What still needs to be done?" I would love to talk with anyone about those topics, please don't be shy! > Why no one uses it if is it so disruptive? still early, and a lot of work to do! we'll get there tho 🙂
